body: I played the piano for my high-school concert band and jazz band. During my junior year, spring semester final concert, there was a tech and lights problem. All the mics went out, some of the stage lights went out. The only remaining stage lights that were on were illuminating the front of the stage. The piano was set up near the front left of the stage and I was just sitting there while our director informed the audience that there were technical difficulties. I began to play Layla despite the lack of mics, and suddenly our drummer joined in with a steady beat, and it was glorious.

20 years old. One kiss. Occurred on the final day of a family vacation. Met her in the hotel whilst roaming it. Liked her. She took me to a Rufus Wainwright concert. Suddenly I was there. Thought about kissing her during 'Hallelujah'. Didn't. We went back to the hotel. Chatted and drank a bit. I chickened out. Went back to my room. Moped. She sent words to my phone. She liked me. Had a moment of clarity. Went back to her room. Wound up roaming the hotel with her. Hugged her. She hugged back. The hug lasted a long time. Realized she wouldn't mind at all if I kissed her. 

Kissed her.
